spoken.text: Next: Single knee to chest. 3 times each leg.
Lie on your back, legs stretched out
Bring one knee up and hold it with both hands
Pull gently and hold the stretch for 10 seconds.
Slowly let go and straighten the leg
Relax
Now bring the other knee up
Pull gently and hold the stretch for 10 seconds.
Slowly let go and straighten the leg
Relax
Next round
Round 2. Bring one knee up and hold it with both hands
Pull gently and hold the stretch for 10 seconds.
Slowly let go and straighten the leg
Relax
Now bring the other knee up
Pull gently and hold the stretch for 10 seconds.
Slowly let go and straighten the leg
Relax
